digest.component_or_area: Rebar Janitor remediation and verification system
propositions: Contributor guidance must use each contributor's real DCO identity; bot identity restricted to explicitly automated workflows
Force flag bypasses all review gates but cannot bypass ticket-system invariants such as open-children close prohibition
LLM verification must reject semantically empty outcomes while maintaining flexible provider-independent parsing and self-healing
Plan review must not pass with ordinary clean result when ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely unless omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant
ChatGPT-specific guidance required for safe Rebar usage in read-only mirror environments without native clone, Gerrit, or tracker access
